props.name: parentSource
props.comment: The field holding the parent's id; a dot or bracket path reads a nested value.

props.name: titleSource
props.comment: The string field shown as the row title; the record representation otherwise.

props.name: iconSource
props.comment: The field whose value picks a component from `iconMap`.

props.name: linkType
props.comment:
Where a row links to when nothing listens to `select`. `edit` by default,
`show` when the resource has no edit view, and an inert row when it has
neither. `false` leaves rows inert.

slots.name: loading
slots.comment: Rendered while the list is pending, in place of `SimpleListLoading`.

slots.name: empty
slots.comment: Rendered with no records, in place of `ListNoResults`.
